lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary diagonal chain of five high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, descending toward the pectoral fin insertion point, surrounded by parallel rows of less defined spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible in the upper-right quadrant, creating a grid-like intersection with the horizontal rows of circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small orange punctate markers are visible on the mid-flank. A white, elongated linear feature is visible trailing the posterior base of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface contains a high-density population of small, high-luminance spots that are notably smaller than those on the lateral flank.
